rationale.headline: Tokyo (4 nights) → Kyoto (2 nights)
reasons: 6 nights suits 2 cities — about one city per 3 nights, so you are not rushing around.
Flights and city-to-city travel add up to 18h 55m including Tokyo → Kyoto (2h 15m).
You land at 10:30 am on day 1 (both flights are direct); you are at your hotel around 1:10 pm.
Hotels average 4.7★ (Ginza Imperial Suites in Tokyo, Higashiyama Machiya Stay in Kyoto) and are all family friendly.
The holiday costs ₹3,45,646 of your ₹3,50,000 budget (99%), leaving ₹4,354.
10 sight(s) planned across 6 day(s) — a mix of district, market, museum, nature.
